Q5460.reason: A painter’s blame of coworkers for a structural collapse is outside his job and not his own negligent act, so it is not a vicarious admission and the hearsay objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: Six weeks after a kidney transplant, tripled BUN/creatinine with suspected rejection is the classic picture of BK virus nephropathy rather than HSV or EBV.

Q5849.reason: Saying computer records were kept on a regular business basis does not satisfy the full Rule 803(6) or authentication foundation, so the court will require more proof of reliability.
